item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 4, 2026 H.E. Andrey Pritsepov met with the Honourable Hugh Todd , Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Guyana, at his request.
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇬🇾 On September 4, 2026 H.E. Andrey Pritsepov met with the Honourable Hugh Todd , Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Guyana, at his request. ❗ The Minister thoroughly outlined Georgetown's foreign policy priorities, emphasizing principles of multipolarity and respect for the interests of all stakeholders. Guyana positions itself as bridge for developing fruitful cooperation between developed and Global South countries. ❗ The Guyanese Minister paid special attention to the upcoming UN Secretary General election and Guyana's candidate Carolyn Rodrigues Birkett . H.Todd noted she has extensive experience in international politics and if elected to this high position will be guided by principle of impartial mediation in resolving international issues. ❗ In response Ambassador emphasized that for Russia competence and impartiality remain the candidates’ key qualities. 🇷🇺 🇬🇾 They discussed upcoming meeting between Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Hugh Todd at the 81st session of the UN GA.

item.title: 🗓 On September 14, 2026, Ambassador of Russia to Indonesia Sergei Tolchenov participated in the opening ceremony of the
item.description: 🗓 On September 14, 2026, Ambassador of Russia to Indonesia Sergei Tolchenov participated in the opening ceremony of the Open Education Center of Ural State Pedagogical University at the Krisnadwipayana University, held for the third consecutive year. 💬 In his welcoming address, Sergei Tolchenov noted: It is particularly important for the younger generation to learn foreign languages, including Russian. We highly value Russian-Indonesian cooperation in the field of education and hope that the Russian language will continue to grow in popularity in Indonesia , giving university and school students an opportunity to discover Russia’s rich culture. 🤝 Deputy Vice-Rector of the Krisnadwipayana University Parbuntian Sinaga described such projects as among the key initiatives contributing to the development of cultural ties between the two countries and thanked the Russian side for its willingness to expand the scope of cooperation . Director of the Institute of Foreign Languages at Ural State Pedagogical University Daria Starkova spoke about plans to continue organising joint events with the Indonesian university. 🎵 A group of pupils from the school of the Embassy performed traditional Russian songs and a dance at the ceremony. 📍 Jakarta

🌟
On 14 September 1944, the Red Army launched the Baltic strategic offensive operation.
Its objectives were to defeat the Nazi army group 'North' and expell the fascist invaders from the territory of the Estonian, Latvian and Lithuanian SSR.
In just two and a half months,
most of the territory of the
#SovietBaltic
was liberated from the Nazis.
Enemy troops operating in the area were cut off from the main Wehrmacht units in East Prussia and
encircled in the Courland Pocket
— the trap where they continued to hopelessly resist until May 1945 — before ultimately being
completely destroyed by the Red Army.
#NoStatuteOfLimitations
Following the Nazi invasion of the Baltic region in the summer of 1941, instead of the promised “independence” to Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, the
Nazis established the terrible and unprecedentedly brutal occupation regime in the Soviet republics
, pursued a policy of
terror and genocide.
Upon the invasion of the Nazis,
local nationalists and members of pro-fascist organisations
in occupied Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia
swore allegiance to Hitler
— infamous collaboratnts known for their atrocities and most heinous crimes on behalf of the Nazis: executing civilians, burning villages, etc.
▪️
Lithuanian, Latvian and Estonian “polizei” units also carried out mass atrocities in neighbouring regions of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic and in
#SovietBelarus
.
Baltic collaborators
played an active role in the Nazi policy of exterminating the Jewish population.
A network of Nazi concentration camps operated throughout the Baltic region, where
tens of thousands of people were murdered.
Among the most horrific Nazi crimes were those committed at the
#Klooga
and the
#Salaspils
“death camps” in Estonia and Latvia respectively.
From among the most radical “patriotic nationalists indoctrinated by fascist propaganda, the
Nazis formed full-fledged Waffen-SS units
, including the so-called Latvian and Estonian Legions. These formations were
used as “human shields” on the Eastern Front
to cover the retreat of regular Wehrmacht units in the summer and autumn of 1944, amid the Red Army rapid advance.
***
⚔️
On 14 September 1944, the forces of the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Red Army's Baltic Fronts launched an offensive towards Riga. During the first three days of the operation alone, the Soviet strike force advanced up to 50 kilometres. On 22 September, the
Nazis were expelled out of Tallinn, and on 13 October, out of Riga.
The final stage of the Soviet offensive in the Baltic region was the
#Moonsund
landing operation
— an operation to liberate the islands of the Moonsund Archipelago in north-western Estonia from the German occupants, including
Ösel
(now
#Saaremaa
) and
Dagö
(now
#Hiiumaa
). It ended in the
complete success of the Red Army
on 24 November 1944.
☝️
The Soviet Baltic national units in the Red Army
also made a significant contribution to the liberation of the region from Nazis and to our common Victory over Germany. Five divisions and two corps formed from Red Army personnel of Estonian, Latvian and Lithuanian origin fought as part of the Soviet Armed Forces on the Eastern Front.
***
#Baltics
#NeoNazism
❗️
Regrettably, in today's Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia, the ruling elites are engaged in erasing from the public consciousness the
sacred Memory of the Great Victory
— a memory cherished by hundreds of thousands of our compatriots and residents of these countries.
The direct descendants of Nazi collaborators in Tallinn, Riga and Vilnius are seeking, by any means, to
whitewash their inglorious past and take revenge for their defeat in 1945.

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 13, President of Russia Vladimir Putin concluded his three-day working visit to India
item.description: 🇷🇺 On September 13, President of Russia Vladimir Putin concluded his three-day working visit to India to attend the XVIII BRICS Summit . Key events of the Summit: 🤝 Visit to the Innoprom.India exhibition 🎙 Vladimir Putin’s address at the BRICS Business Forum 🎙 Vladimir Putin’s address at the XVIII BRICS Summit 🎙 Vladimir Putin’s address at the Outreach/BRICS Plus Session of the XVIII BRICS Summit ✍️ On September 12, The XVIII BRICS Summit adopted the New Delhi Declaration “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability” : Bearing in mind the need to adapt the current architecture of international relations to better reflect the contemporary realities, we reiterate our commitment to strengthening multilateralism and multipolarity and to upholding international law, including the Purposes and Principles of the UN Charter in their entirety and interconnectedness in a balanced and inclusive manner, as its indispensable cornerstone, and the central role of the #UN in the international system. 📃 Full text of the Declaration *** On the sidelines of the BRICS Summit, President of Russia Vladimir Putin also held a series of bilateral meetings with: 🇮🇳 Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi 🇿🇦 President of South Africa Cyril Ramaphosa 🇪🇬 President of Egypt Abdel Fattah el-Sisi 🇲🇾 Prime Minister of Malaysia Anwar Ibrahim 🇪🇹 Prime Minister of Ethiopia Abiy Ahmed 🇦🇪 Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan 🤝 President of the New Development Bank

item.title: 🗓 On September 14, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held a meeting with candidate for the post of UN Secretary-General
item.description: 🗓 On September 14, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held a meeting with candidate for the post of UN Secretary-General Olara Otunnu (Uganda). Olara Otunnu presented his election platform . Minister Lavrov outlined Russia’s requirements for candidates for the highest post in the UN Secretariat . #UNCharterIsOurRules : Both Sides reaffirmed their commitment to the UN’s central coordinating role in world affairs .
